label: Line 6 Bass POD Pro
note: Live MIDI CC control map for the Bass POD Pro (Line 6, "Fast Forward" / Yamaha, SysEx ID 00 01 0C, family 02 00). Every control below is a real-time control-change message on the POD's global MIDI channel; nothing here needs a SysEx dump. Values and names are taken from the cross-reference table in mapping/bass_pod_pro_mapping.ods, with the message envelope verified against mapping/Bass POD Pro Sysex - English .pdf.

programs.note: Internal programs 1A-9D. Program change 0 is Manual mode and PC 37 is the tuner - both are front-panel buttons on the hardware rather than memories.

effects.name: Danish Driver
effects.modeled: T.C. Electronics Booster Line Driver + Distortion

controls.label: Amp Model
controls.title: The POD's amp model. 16 models (0-15), each one a Line 6 model of a real bass amp.

controls.label: Drive
controls.title: Input drive into the amp model. 0-126 (the POD's control-change range stops one short of 127).

controls.label: Bass
controls.title: Low shelf of the amp model's tone stack. 0-126.

controls.label: Middle
controls.title: Mid band of the amp model's tone stack. 0-126.

controls.label: Treble
controls.title: High shelf of the amp model's tone stack. 0-126.

controls.label: Channel Vol
controls.title: Volume of the selected amp channel. 0-126.

controls.label: Compress
controls.title: Compression amount. Scales the compressor's threshold; the ratio/attack/decay themselves are sys-ex-only parameters and aren't live CC controls on the POD.

controls.label: Param Freq
controls.title: Centre frequency of the parametric band, 30Hz-8kHz. 0-126.

controls.label: Param Q
controls.title: Width of the parametric band. 0-126.

controls.label: Param Gain
controls.title: Cut/boost of the parametric band, -15dB to +24dB. 0-126.

controls.label: Mid Sweep
controls.title: Moves the amp model's mid-frequency centre. 0-126.

controls.label: Effect Select
controls.title: Which of the POD's 16 effects is loaded (0-15). NOTE: this control number comes from the PDF's control-number column - the ODS cross-reference lists the effect names but no CC number for the selector - so it's the one mapping here worth confirming against hardware.

controls.label: Effect Tweak
controls.title: The selected effect's main parameter. 0-126. CC 1 is the mod-wheel position on a general MIDI device; the POD simply uses it as this knob.

controls.label: FX Lo-Cut
controls.title: High-pass filter on the effect path, off to 1kHz. 0-126.

controls.label: Cabinet
controls.title: Speaker cabinet/mic model. 16 cabinets (0-15). Value 10 is Bypass - the cabinet simulation off.

controls.label: Gate
controls.title: Noise gate amount. 0-127 here, unlike the other knobs: values 0-63 switch the gate off and 64-127 switch it on, with the position inside each half setting the level.

controls.label: Dig Out Level
controls.title: Level of the POD's digital output. 0-126. This is a system-wide setting on the POD rather than part of an individual program.

controls.label: Apply FX to D.I.
controls.title: Whether the effects feed the D.I. output as well as the main outs. System-wide (0=off, 127=on), not part of an individual program.

controls.label: Manual
controls.title: Switches the POD to Manual mode - the front panel knobs control the sound directly instead of a stored program.

controls.label: Tuner
controls.title: Switches the POD to its tuner. Program change 37 is the tuner on this device.
